ai_summary: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited reported robust consolidated financial performance for Q1 FY2026-27, with significant increases in revenue (12.14%), EBIDTA (175.06%), and Profit After Tax (654.90%). This dramatic growth was primarily propelled by the new Rice Bran Oil Extraction plant, which contributed over 50% of consolidated EBIDTA, materially impacting overall profitability. While the standalone railway business experienced a slight 4.86% revenue decline, its EBIDTA margin improved, indicating efficient operations despite shifting business drivers.
